q: Is caustic soda exported to Europe covered by CBAM?
title: Is caustic soda covered by CBAM?
short: No. Caustic soda (2815) and chlorine (2801) are not in Annex I. Hydrogen (2804 10) is, so a chlor-alkali plant selling hydrogen to an EU buyer would need a figure, though that is rare from India. Buyers may still ask for a caustic footprint.
audience: Chlor-alkali producers exporting caustic soda lye or flakes

p: Electricity per tonne of caustic by source, steam for concentration and flaking, and how emissions are shared between caustic, chlorine and hydrogen.
Named chlor-alkali plants have emission intensity targets under CCTS, which is separate from CBAM.

senseible: Senseible reads your fuel and electricity invoices into dated, fingerprinted records, so if a buyer asks for a product footprint you can answer from documents rather than estimates.
